name: How long does a typical custom kitchen renovation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical custom kitchen renovation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a custom kitchen renovation can vary significantly based on the project's scope and complexity. A small-scale remodel might take 4-8 weeks from demolition to completion. More extensive projects involving layout changes, custom cabinetry, or structural modifications could extend to 10-16 weeks or more. Factors like material lead times, inspection schedules, and unforeseen issues can also impact the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule at the outset.
acceptedAnswer.description: Typical custom kitchen renovations can take 4-16 weeks, depending on the project's scope, complexity, and material lead times.
